items.summary: Finance review: escalate to owner. Current evidence supports only $4.92 Amazon commission from 6,219 clicks on 2026-09-21, with incomplete site attribution. Analytics is unavailable; site-level revenue, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, payback, CAC, total operating spend, and forecasts are unsupported. Recommend keeping the property private until attribution, margin inputs, cost controls, and launch measurement criteria are defined. No spending, billing, or production change is authorized.
